verdict.rationale: Reducto's enterprise deployment options include dedicated VPC and hybrid VPC models in which all data and storage sit in the customer's own VPC. That effectively lets customers control where data lives, but only through enterprise-grade deployment rather than a simple region choice. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection (e.g. EU vs US) for the hosted SaaS tier, documentation of which regions are available, and independent corroboration of the VPC data-residency setup.
